html: רעם (√ of foll., prob. onomatop.; Gerber47 proposes move violently as orig. meaning, but ref. to thunderous sound everywhere, except Ez 27:35 where text dub., v. infr.; cf. Aramaic רַעַם רְעִים n. thunder, רְעֵם vb. thunder; especially Aph. Ithpa. utter (loud) complaints; ܪܥܶܡ, ܪܰܥܡܳܐ n. thunder, ܪܥܶܡ vb. thunder, lament, cf. NH רָעַם Hiph. thunder, Hithp. complain; Ethiopic ረዓም n. thunder, Assyrian rîmu, id.; Arabic رَغِمَ vex, dislike, etc.).
